first_red.first_red_rule: The authorized Link 26 was consumed. No retry, restage, hardware run or downstream claim followed.

bss.interpretation: No new static data was allocated; unchanged BSS was displaced upward by the resident-code growth and then collided with the fixed C2 block.

logical_pc_relative_branch_fix.mechanism: The correct logical-PC target and streamed-window reload logic was expressed as a macro at both OP_JMPREL and OP_JFALSEREL sites, so LTO emitted the large path twice in the already constrained resident interpreter.

operational_gc_root_scan_fix.mechanism: The approved contiguous 32-byte root-plane scan replaced 283 individual reads; LTO folded its loop into the resident collector. No 32-byte BSS object was introduced.

root_cause.mechanism: Link 25 left only 26 bytes between ordinary resident text and the fixed handoff at 0xb481. Both Link-26 fixes were emitted into that corridor even though their combined resident cost was 733 bytes. The failure is placement and duplication, not a request to weaken either semantic fix or any capacity boundary.

recommended_bounded_probe: Deduplicate relative-branch handling behind one non-inline logical-PC seam; direct out-of-array C-pointer arithmetic remains forbidden.
Place the C2-only logical target helper in the already owned fixed 0xe000 window, not in the 26-byte resident corridor.
Place the blockwise C2 root walker in the same C2-owned window and add exactly one explicit three-byte stable facade vector for its call to Bank-0 gc_mark.

Prove that neither helper is reachable before KERNAL ownership, re-run the complete control-flow and KERNAL-freedom gates, and price the real window/facade deltas against Link 25's 1404-byte 0xe000 margin and 273-byte fixed-Bank-0 margin.
Exactly one real successor link only after separate authorization; first-red remains first-red.
inadmissible_alternatives: Raise or move the fixed handoff/layout boundaries.
Restore forced product GCs or per-root DMA reads from the host stress schedule.
Stage or claim hardware evidence from the failed Link 26 seed.

claim_limit: Static capacity first-red only. Link 26 produced no product candidate and proves no structural, hardware, promotion or release claim.
